questions.stem: What is meant by the carrying capacity of an environment?

options.text: The total number of different species in an area
The maximum population size that an environment can sustainably support
The minimum number of organisms needed to maintain a population
The rate at which a population grows over time

questions.explanation: Carrying capacity is the maximum population size that an environment can sustain indefinitely, given the available resources such as food, water, and space. When a population reaches carrying capacity, growth slows or stops.
